card.statement:
Assume $G$ is solvable and let $G^{\prime}$ be equal to $JLG$, $LJG,JJG$ or $G^{(2)}$. Then there exists an ind-affine ind-scheme

$\Sigma[G^{\prime}]\subset LLG$

such that for all $k$ algebras $R$, every element in $LLG(R)/G^{\prime}(R)$ has a unique representative in $\Sigma[G^{\prime}](R)$.

A similar result holds in the case of the affine Grassmannian of the jet group $LJG/JJG$: there exists $\Sigma^{J}\subset LJG$ and ${}^{J}\Sigma_{G}\subset JLG$ with analogous properties.

This implies that the Grassmannians $\mathcal{G}r^{L}_{G}$, ${}^{L}\mathcal{G}r_{G}$, $\mathcal{G}r^{J}_{G}$, $\mathcal{G}r^{big}_{G}$ and $\mathcal{G}r^{(2)}_{G}$ from ${\mathsf{CAlg}}_{k}$ to $\mathsf{Set}$ of Definition 1.5 are ind-affine ind-schemes and, in particular, they are sheaves for the fppf topology.

Depending on which affine Grassmannian from Definition 1.5 we are considering, we denote the corresponding ind-schemes by $\Sigma^{L}_{G}$, ${}^{L}\Sigma_{G},\Sigma_{G}^{\mathrm{big}},\Sigma_{G}^{(2)}$, $\Sigma_{G}^{J}$.
card.label: Theorem 1.7

paper.title: Two dimensional versions of the affine Grassmannian and their geometric description
paper.abstract: For a smooth affine algebraic group $G$ over an algebraically closed field, we consider several two-variables generalizations of the affine Grassmannian $G(\!(t)\!)/G[\![t]\!]$, given by quotients of the double loop group $G(\!(x)\!)(\!(y)\!)$. We prove that they are representable by ind-schemes if $G$ is solvable. Given a smooth surface $X$ and a flag of subschemes of $X$, we provide a geometric interpretation of the two-variables Grassmannians, in terms of bundles and trivialisation data defined on appropriate loci in $X$, which depend on the flag.
